purpose: Independent zero-GPU first-party cross-domain test of the STRI support-overlap mechanism using Skill-SP's released logical-reasoning compilers and fixed CSP truth, without LLM generation.

units.selection_basis: exactly the author validate_compiler_spec default validation sizes and default seeds=4 over all eight released logical skills

generation.blueprint: fixed author-style compiler-validation blueprint with house_count x attribute_count, deterministic neutral value sets, task_family=zebra_grid, and medium/hard difficulty based only on size

independent_truth.task_validity: logical_reasoning.contracts.check_zebra_sample_contract with fixed CSP count_solutions uniqueness validation

analysis.support_matrix: 128 generated source units x 8 released target compiler specs
analysis.primary_reduction: optimal nonnegative global package weighting over the same support matrix with minimum covered-unit exposure normalized to 1
analysis.certificate: STRI-Cert global-singleton overlap witness where available; LP optimum is the general same-information reduction

decision_rule.CROSS_DOMAIN_PACKAGE_ONLY_RESIDUAL: all 128 source units compile and pass author CSP contract, at least one unit has multi-skill support, and the optimal same-information global package-weight ratio is > 1 + 1e-8
decision_rule.DISJOINT_OR_EQUALIZABLE_NEGATIVE_CONTROL: all 128 source units compile and pass author CSP contract and optimal global package-weight ratio is <= 1 + 1e-8
decision_rule.INVALID_FIRST_PARTY_SUBSTRATE: any source unit fails author compile/contract or repository/compiler hashes drift
decision_rule.NO_SIMPLE_WITNESS_BUT_LP_RESIDUAL: LP ratio >1 is sufficient for the residual even when the closed-form singleton-overlap witness does not fire; do not select a subset to create a witness

interpretation.positive: Independent first-party logical domain supports the same package-only representation residual under author compiler support truth; strengthens C2 cross-domain generality but still does not establish downstream utility harm or SQC performance.
interpretation.negative: Logical domain is a real negative boundary; retain tool-call C2 only and report that the mechanism depends on support topology.
interpretation.invalid: No scientific belief update; do not repair seeds/sizes/specs after outcome.
